name: tx.origin Authorization (Solidity)
attack_scenario: tx.origin is the account that started the transaction chain, not the immediate caller; the victim owner is phished into calling an attacker contract, which calls the vulnerable contract where tx.origin is still the owner, passing the check and draining funds (SWC-115)
negative_test_hint: call the guarded function through an "intermediary attacker contract" as a non-owner and assert it reverts - tx.origin must not authorize it

exemplar.explanation: authorize on msg.sender (the immediate caller), never tx.origin, so an intermediary contract cannot act on the victim's behalf
